<h3>SHIPPING:</h3>
<p>Free Shipping promotion is only valid for shipping addresses in the United States excluding Alaska, Hawaii, US Virgin Islands, Puerto Rico, Guam, military and air force bases. Please note, this promotion may not be combined with any other offers unless explicitly noted. <br/> <br/> <b style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;">Expedited orders must be placed before 1pm ET.</b><br/> We also offer expedited shipping – two day and next day on merchandise that is in stock.<br/>For further details, please visit our <a href="/content.jsp?pageName=ShippingPolicy" title="Shipping Policy">Shipping Policy</a> page.</p>
<h3>RETURNS:</h3>
<p>For your convenience, we accept returns for items purchased at Steven and Steve Madden stores (only stores in the USA excluding Colorado and Utah locations and Steve Madden Outlets). We gladly accept returns of unworn merchandise within 30 days of delivery. <br/> <br/> If there is no store near you then you may obtain return authorization via phone, Live Chat, e-mail or by <a href="/user/login.jsp" title="Sign In">signing into</a> your account and going into your order. The authorization requests must be made within 30 days from when your order is delivered. <br/> <br/> Shipping charges are not refundable and there is a $6.95 plus tax per order return fee that covers restocking and postage back to the warehouse. Clearance items and earring purchases cannot be returned or exchanged. <br/> <br/> Click here to view our full <a href="/content.jsp?pageName=ReturnPolicy" title="Return Policy">Return Policy</a></p>

  $(document).ready(function(){
    window.onload = function() {
      function videoPlay() {
        var video = document.getElementById("video_1571817639596");
        if(video) {
          if(video.readyState === 4) {
            video.play(); 
          } else {
            setTimeout(function(){
              videoPlay();
            },500);
          }
        }
      }

      videoPlay()      
    };
  });

  $(function(){
    $('#agreementSMPass').click(function(){
      if($(this).is(':checked')){
        $('input[name="telephone"]').prop('required',true);
        $('input[name="pcode"]').prop('required',true);
      } else {
        $('input[name="telephone"]').prop('required',false);
        $('input[name="pcode"]').prop('required',false);
      }
    });

  });
</script>

<style>
  .dangerFocus{ border: 1px solid red;}
  .dangerContent{ color:red;margin:10px 0px;}
  .loadingSpinner 
  {
          border: 4px solid #FFF;
          border-top-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);
          border-left-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);
          width: 20px;
          height: 20px;
          opacity: 0.8;
          border-radius: 50%;
          animation: loadingSpinner 0.7s infinite linear;
          -webkit-animation: loadingSpinner 0.7s infinite linear;
  }

  .btn-lodar.spinning:after 
  {
          content: "";
          position: absolute;
          left: 0;
          right: 0;
          top: 0;
          bottom: 0;
          background: #1c397b;
          z-index: 1;
  }

  .btn-lodar .loadingSpinner 
  {
          z-index: 9;
          position: absolute;
          top: 20%;
          left: 40%;
  }

  @keyframes loadingSpinner 
  {
          from { transform: rotate(0deg);  }

          to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
  }

  @-webkit-keyframes loadingSpinner 
  {
          from { -webkit-transform: rotate(0deg);  }

          to { -webkit-transform: rotate(360deg);  }
  }

</style>
<script>
    (function ()
    {
        var loadScript = function (url, callback)
        {
            var script = document.createElement("script");
            script.type = "text/javascript";
            // If the browser is Internet Explorer.
            if (script.readyState)
            {
                script.onreadystatechange = function ()
                {
                    if (script.readyState == "loaded" || script.readyState == "complete") {
                        script.onreadystatechange = null;                      
                        callback();
                    }
                };
                // For any other browser.
            } else {
                script.onload = function () {                   
                    callback();
                };
            }
            script.src = url;
            document.getElementsByTagName("head")[0].appendChild(script);
        };
      
        var newsLetterEvents = function($)
        {			    
            var newsURL ="https://services.stevemadden.ca/";          
          
            var SubscribeNewsLetter = function()
            {
                $.ajax({
                    type: "POST",
                    url: newsURL + 'Responsys/AddNewsLetter',
                    data: {
                            "email":$("#moreAboutYou [name='email']").val().trim(),
                            "page":"Footer",
                            "newsletter":"",
                            "last_name":$("#moreAboutYou [name='Lname']").val(),
                            "gender_type":"",
                            "first_name":$("#moreAboutYou [name='fname']").val(),
                            "loyaltyFlag":$("#moreAboutYou [name='agreementSMPass']").prop('checked').toString(),
                            "phone":$("#moreAboutYou [name='telephone']").val(),
                            "postalCode":$("#moreAboutYou [name='pcode']").val().trim(),
                          },
                    dataType: "json",
                    crossDomain: true,
                    success: function (data) {
                      if(data.Status==1)
                      {
                         $("#addMoreButton").html("Submit").removeClass('spinning');                         
                         //$("#moreAboutYou").submit();
                         $(".cls_popup").click();
                      }
                      else 
                      {
                         $("#addMoreButton").html("Submit").removeClass('spinning');
                         alert("some problem occured please try again later.");
                      }
                    },
                    error: function (e) {
                      $("#addMoreButton").html("Submit").removeClass('spinning');
                      console.log(e);
                    }
                });                            	
          	};          
          	
          	var checkUniquePhone = function()
            {
              	//var urlAction="https://services.stevemadden.com/Loyalty/CheckRegisterDetails";      
                $.ajax({
                      url: newsURL + "Loyalty/CheckRegisterDetails",
                      type: "POST",
                      data: { "phone": $("#moreAboutYou [name='telephone']").val(),"zipCode":$("#moreAboutYou [name='pcode']").val()},
                      success: function (result) {              
                         if(result.Status==1)
                         {                                                                                       
                            SubscribeNewsLetter();
                         }
                         else
                         {       
                            $("#addMoreButton").html("Submit").removeClass('spinning');
                            if(result.Message.indexOf('zip')>-1)
                            {
                               $("#moreAboutYou [name='pcode']").before('<span class="dangerContent"> '+ result.Message+'</span>');
                            }
                            else
                            {   
                               $("#moreAboutYou [name='telephone']").before("<span class='dangerContent'> Phone Number Already Exits </span>");
                            }
                         }
                      },
                      error: function (result) { $("#addMoreButton").html("Submit").removeClass('spinning');  },
                  }); 
            };
          
          	var ValidateData = function()
            {                           
                $(".dangerContent").remove();              
              	if($("#moreAboutYou [name='email']").val().trim() == "")
                {
                  	$("#moreAboutYou [name='email']").focus().addClass('dangerFocus').before("<span class='dangerContent'> required </span>");
                    $("#addMoreButton").html("Submit").removeClass('spinning');
                   	return false;
                }
              	else 
                {
                  	$("#moreAboutYou [name='email']").removeClass('dangerFocus');
                }
              
              	if($("#moreAboutYou [name='fname']").val().trim() == "")
                {
                  	$("#moreAboutYou [name='fname']").focus().addClass('dangerFocus').before("<span class='dangerContent'> required </span>");
                    $("#addMoreButton").html("Submit").removeClass('spinning');
                   	return false;
                }
              	else 
                {
                  	$("#moreAboutYou [name='fname']").removeClass('dangerFocus');
                }
              
              	if($("#moreAboutYou [name='Lname']").val().trim() == "")
                {
                  	$("#moreAboutYou [name='Lname']").focus().addClass('dangerFocus').before("<span class='dangerContent'> required </span>");
                    $("#addMoreButton").html("Submit").removeClass('spinning');
                   	return false;
                }
              	else 
                {
                  	$("#moreAboutYou [name='Lname']").removeClass('dangerFocus');
                }
              	
              	if($("#moreAboutYou [name='agreementSMPass']").prop('checked'))
                {
                  	if($("#moreAboutYou [name='pcode']").val().trim() == "")
                    {
                        $("#moreAboutYou [name='pcode']").focus().addClass('dangerFocus').before("<span class='dangerContent'> required </span>");
                        $("#addMoreButton").html("Submit").removeClass('spinning');
                        return false;
                    }
                    else 
                    {
                        $("#moreAboutYou [name='pcode']").removeClass('dangerFocus');
                    }
                  
                  	if($("#moreAboutYou [name='telephone']").val().trim() == "")
                    {
                        $("#moreAboutYou [name='telephone']").focus().addClass('dangerFocus').before("<span class='dangerContent'> required </span>");
                        $("#addMoreButton").html("Submit").removeClass('spinning');
                        return false;
                    }
                    else 
                    {
                        $("#moreAboutYou [name='telephone']").removeClass('dangerFocus');
                    }                  
                  	checkUniquePhone();                    
                }
                else
                {
                   SubscribeNewsLetter();
                }
              
            };
          	
          	$("#addMoreButton").click(function()
            {
              	$(this).addClass('spinning').html("<div Class='loadingSpinner'></div>");
              	ValidateData();               
            });
        };
      
        if ((typeof jQuery === 'undefined') || (parseFloat(jQuery.fn.jquery) < 1.7))
        {
            loadScript('//code.jquery.com/jquery-2.2.4.min.js', function ()
            {
                jQuery224 = jQuery.noConflict(true);
                newsLetterEvents(jQuery224);
            });
        }
        else
        {
            newsLetterEvents(jQuery);
        }
      
      
    })();
</script>

    jQuery(function() {
      jQuery('.swatch :radio').change(function() {
        var optionIndex = jQuery(this).closest('.swatch').attr('data-option-index');
        var optionValue = jQuery(this).val();
        jQuery(this)
        .closest('form')
        .find('.single-option-selector')
        .eq(optionIndex)
        .val(optionValue)
        .trigger('change');
        
        if($(this).closest('.select_size').length) {
          localStorage.setItem("sizeVariant", optionValue);
        }
        
        if($(this).hasClass('isColor')){
          var pro = $(this).attr('data-product');
          var cdataValue = jQuery(this).attr('data-value');
          $('.pro-'+pro).find('.proImgClrGroup').hide();
          $('.largeImgSlider-'+pro+'[data-color="'+cdataValue+'"]').show();
          $('.thumbImgSlider-'+pro+'[data-color="'+cdataValue+'"]').show();
          if($('.largeImgSlider-'+pro).hasClass('slick-initialized')) {
            $('.thumbImgSlider-'+pro).slick('refresh');
            $('.largeImgSlider-'+pro).slick('refresh');
          }
        }
      });
      
      if(localStorage.getItem("sizeVariant")) {
        var sv = localStorage.getItem("sizeVariant");
        if($('.select_size input[value="'+sv+'"]').length) {
          if($('.select_size input[value="'+sv+'"]').hasClass('sold')) {
            $('<p class="err-msg">Size '+sv+' is sold out for this color.</p>').insertAfter('.select_size');
          } else {
            $('.select_size input[value="'+sv+'"]').trigger('click');
          }
        } else {
          $('<p class="err-msg">Size '+sv+' is not available for this color !</p>').insertAfter('.select_size');
        }
        localStorage.removeItem('sizeVariant');
        setTimeout(function(){
          $('.err-msg').remove();
        },10000);
      }
      
    });
    
  </script>

    (function () {
      var baseURL = "https://services.stevemadden.ca/";
      //var baseURL = "https://00e828cd.ngrok.io/";
      var loadScript = function (url, callback) {
        var script = document.createElement("script");
        script.type = "text/javascript";
        // If the browser is Internet Explorer.
        if (script.readyState) {
          script.onreadystatechange = function () {
            if (script.readyState == "loaded" || script.readyState == "complete") {
              script.onreadystatechange = null;
              callback();
            }
          };
          // For any other browser.
        } else {
          script.onload = function () {
            callback();
          };
        }
        script.src = url;
        document.getElementsByTagName("head")[0].appendChild(script);
      };

          if(email){

              		email: email,

              	AjaxAddNewsLetter(mydata);

          }

        $("#btnAccountResetPassword").on("click",function(){
          // This prevents the form from submitting
          event.preventDefault();

          var password = $("#customer_password").val().trim();
          var rePassword = $("#customer_password_confirmation").val().trim();
          if(password && rePassword){
            var param = {
              customerId: '',
              formname:"changepass",
              currentEmail:'',
              newPassword:$("#customer_password").val(),
              reNewPassword:$("#customer_password_confirmation").val(),
            };
            $.ajax({
              type: "POST",
              url: baseURL+'Responsys/UpdateCustomer',
              data: param,
              dataType:"json",
              crossDomain: true,
              success:function(json){
                $(".updatepassmsg span").html(json.Message);
                $(".updatepassmsg span").delay(5000).fadeOut('slow');
              },
              error:function() {
                // ...  display Erro msg
              }
            });
          }
        });

          var ne = $("#newEmail").val().trim();
          var rne = $("#reNewEmail").val().trim();
          var cemail = '';
          var emailReg = "";

            var param = {
              customerId: '',
              formname:"changeemail",
              currentEmail:email,
              newEmailAddress:ne,
              reNewEmail:rne,
            };

              type: "POST",
              url: baseURL+'Responsys/UpdateCustomer',
              data: param,

                // ...  display Erro msg
              }
            });
          }
        });

    		return pattern.test(emailAddress);

        $('img.mainImg').on("click",function(){
          $(this).addClass('current');
          $('body').addClass('ovfHidden');
          $('body').append('<div class="zoomImgsWrap"><div class="zoomImgsCont"></div> <button class="closeZoom">X</button></div>');
          $(this).closest('.featured').find('.mainImg').each(function() {
            if($(this).hasClass('current'))
              $('.zoomImgsCont').append('<img  class="zoomTo" src="'+$(this).attr('data-img')+'" alt="'+pt+'" />');
            else
              $('.zoomImgsCont').append('<img  src="'+$(this).attr('data-img')+'" alt="'+pt+'" />');
          });

          var imgs = $(".zoomImgsCont img");
          var count = imgs.length;

          imgs.load(function() {
            count--;
            if (!count) {
              //setTimeout(function(){
                var s = $(".zoomImgsCont img.zoomTo").position().top;
                $('.zoomImgsCont').animate({ scrollTop: s }, 1000);
              //},500);
            }
          }).filter(function() { return this.complete; }).load();

        });

        $('body').on("click",'.closeZoom', function(){
          closeZoom()
        });
        $(document).keyup(function(e) {
          if (e.keyCode == 27) {
            closeZoom();
          }
        });

        var closeZoom = function () {
          $('.zoomImgsWrap').remove();
          $('body').removeClass('ovfHidden');
          $('.mainImg').removeClass('current');
        }
      };

<script>
  $(function(){
    function getCookie(cname) {
      var name = cname + "=";
      var decodedCookie = document.cookie;
      var ca = decodedCookie.split(';');
      for(var i = 0; i <ca.length; i++) {
        var c = ca[i];
        while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') {
          c = c.substring(1);
        }
        if (c.indexOf(name) == 0) {
          return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
        }
      }
      return "";
    }
    function setCookie(cname, cvalue, exdays) {
      var d = new Date();
      d.setTime(d.getTime() + (exdays*24*60*60*1000));
      var expires = "expires="+ d.toUTCString();
      document.cookie = cname + "=" + cvalue + ";" + expires + ";path=/";
    }
    if(getCookie('popup') != 'yes') {
      setTimeout(function(){
        $('.homepage-modal').modal({ 
          fadeDuration: 100,
          closeText: ''
        });
        setCookie('popup', 'yes', 15);
      }, 2000);
    }

  });
</script>

<script>

	(function () 
	{
		var loadScript = function (url, callback) 
		{
            var script = document.createElement("script");
            script.type = "text/javascript";
            // If the browser is Internet Explorer.
            if (script.readyState) 
			{
                script.onreadystatechange = function () 
				{
                    if (script.readyState == "loaded" || script.readyState == "complete") 
					{
                        script.onreadystatechange = null;
                        callback();
                    }
                };                
            } else {
                script.onload = function () 
				{
                    callback();
                };
            }
            script.src = url;
            document.getElementsByTagName("head")[0].appendChild(script);
        };
		
		var preOrderMessage = function($)
		{
			
			var getCookie = function(cname)
			{
				var name = cname + "=";
				var ca = document.cookie.split(';');
				for(var i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) 
				{
					var c = ca[i];
					while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') 
					{
						c = c.substring(1);
					}
					if (c.indexOf(name) == 0) 
					{
						return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
					}
				}
				return "";
			};
		
			var AddCookie = function(cname, cvalue, exdays)
			{
				var d = new Date();
				d.setTime(d.getTime() + (exdays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
				var expires = "expires="+d.toUTCString();
				document.cookie = cname + "=" + cvalue + ";" + expires + ";path=/";
			};
		
			var ShowMessage = function()
			{
				if($("[data-product-id]").length>0)
				{          
					var preorderMessag="";
					$("[data-product-id]").each(function()
					{        
						preorderMessage = getCookie($(this).attr("data-product-id"));                          
						if(preorderMessage != undefined && preorderMessage!=null && preorderMessage!="" && $(this).parents('a').find('.Loyalty_LineItem[data-key="Pre-ordered items"]').length>0)
						{           
							$(this).html(preorderMessage);
						}
					});
				}
                             
			};
		
			ShowMessage();			
			if(window.location.href.indexOf('/products')>-1)
			{  		
				$(document).on("click","#pre-order",function()
				{                          	
					if($("#pre-order").is(':visible'))
					{        	
						AddCookie(meta.product.id,$(".tooltipster-content").html(),365);   
						setTimeout(function(){ ShowMessage() }, 2500);      		
					}        
				});
			}
		};
		
		if ((typeof jQuery === 'undefined') || (parseFloat(jQuery.fn.jquery) < 1.7))
        {
            loadScript('//code.jquery.com/jquery-2.2.4.min.js', function ()
            {
                jQuery224 = jQuery.noConflict(true);              	
              	preOrderMessage(jQuery224);                
            });
        }
        else
        {            
            preOrderMessage(jQuery);
        }
		
	})();
	 
</script>
<script src="https://static.cdn-apple.com/businesschat/start-chat-button/2/index.js"></script>
